stack_name: Coinbase AgentKit + CDP Agentic Wallet + x402 Buyers
speaks_to: You are an AgentKit agent (LangChain / Eliza / OpenAI Agents SDK / Vercel AI SDK) holding a CDP wallet, or an MCP client on the Agentic Wallet MCP server. Read this before your next x402 tap.

wallet_capability.wallet_type: CDP non-custodial TEE (API-key auth); OTP email session for Agentic Wallet MCP

payment_call_mechanism.how_agent_calls_paid_tools: AgentKit action provider is registered as an LLM-callable tool. You call it by name; an x402 axios/fetch wrapper intercepts the HTTP 402, reads the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, signs a USDC EIP-3009/Permit2 authorization, retries with X-PAYMENT, and the CDP facilitator verifies on-chain. Bazaar (AgentCore Gateway) provides runtime endpoint discovery.
payment_call_mechanism.payment_auth_method: CDP API key (server-side); OTP email session (Agentic Wallet MCP)

expected_x402_flow: GET paid endpoint with wallet-equipped client
x402 wrapper signs USDC authorization for the stated amount/network
CDP facilitator verifies on Base (eip155:8453); server returns 200 + resource

spend_policy_assumptions.note: Policy is session-limit enforced at the enclave. A retry loop can exhaust max_per_session before the task completes; rejection on cap is opaque and is easily mistaken for a transient error (FM-04).

primary_failure_mode.description: You retry the x402 payment tool with no exit condition. Each retry triggers a new payment. Step count is unbounded and session budget drains before the task completes.
primary_failure_mode.payment_consequence: Session spend limit reached; subsequent payment calls blocked; you stall or fail without completing the task. If no session limit is set, wallet balance drains.

observable_trigger_signals.signal: Repeated HTTP 402 on the same endpoint, retry count incrementing without step progression
observable_trigger_signals.source: agent execution logs / AgentKit tool-call trace

observable_trigger_signals.signal: Session spend approaching max-per-session threshold before task completion
observable_trigger_signals.source: CDP console / wallet UI spend tracker

observable_trigger_signals.signal: Wallet notification: cannot make payments (auth or balance)
Bazaar / x402 registry query returns empty set for required service category
npx @coinbase/payments-mcp status exits non-zero / shows connection error

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: 402 retries climbing on the same endpoint / you sense a loop
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: named distress_class (loop_detected / payment_uncertainty) + the one deep pack to call next + stop/preserve/continue + escalate_if

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: PAYMENT-REQUIRED header looks malformed or you cannot build a valid payload
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: x402 format diagnosis on the 402 payload

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: about to authorize a paid tool and unsure it is worth it
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: pay / do-not-pay decision support before you sign

recommended_second_eyes_routes.when: Bazaar returns empty for the service you need
recommended_second_eyes_routes.returns: Bazaar index check for endpoint discovery

priority_rationale: Largest deployed wallet-equipped agent base. x402 is the de facto micropayment standard and Coinbase is the standard setter. Most recoverable failure modes map directly to observable signals — fastest path to demonstrated value.
source_brief: Second Eyes Agent Lounge — Wallet-Equipped Agent Target Map (research June 2025)
